trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with a calculated vertex angle of approximately 55 degrees and a vertical depth occupying roughly 15% of the visible lobe height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency irregular serration pattern across the entire trailing boundary; primary peaks exhibit pixel-amplitudes between 5 and 15 pixels relative to the mean edge curve.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: A continuous convex sweep originating from the median notch and extending symmetrically towards the distal tips of both fluke lobes.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple high-intensity white pixel clusters (rosettes) localized exclusively at the extreme lateral tips (distal margins) of both the left and right lobes, consistent with barnacle colonization.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Dense clusters of white calcified barnacles along the outer trailing margins and tips of both fluke lobes.
